reason: Implements GA4 Admin and Data API calls with 22 GA4 tools; also exposes 6 Search Console, 6 AdSense and 1 authentication-status tool.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Check the authentication status of the Google Marketing MCP server. Use this to verify OAuth is configured correctly before using other tools.
tools.behavior: Checks GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET presence and locally stored tokens; reports status. Token validity here means a stored refresh_token is nonempty, with no Google API verification.
notes: No OAuth flow is invoked by this tool; authentication/login/logout are CLI commands, not MCP tools.

tools.name: ga4_list_accounts
tools.description: List all GA4 accounts accessible by the authenticated user
notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
tools.behavior: Calls Analytics Admin API listAccounts and returns selected response fields as JSON text.

tools.name: ga4_list_properties
tools.description: List all GA4 properties under a specific account
notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.

notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
tools.behavior: Creates an Admin property under accountId with displayName, timeZone, currencyCode and optional industryCategory.

tools.name: ga4_get_property
tools.description: Get details of a specific GA4 property
notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.

tools.name: ga4_update_property
tools.description: Update settings of a GA4 property
notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
At least one update field must be provided; this requirement is handler-only.
tools.behavior: Updates supplied displayName, timeZone and/or currencyCode via Admin updateProperty with an explicit updateMask.

tools.name: ga4_delete_property
tools.description: Soft-delete a GA4 property (moves to trash, can be recovered within 35 days)
notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
tools.behavior: Calls Admin deleteProperty and returns the deleted property metadata and trash confirmation.

tools.name: ga4_create_web_stream

notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
tools.behavior: Creates a WEB_DATA_STREAM under propertyId with displayName and webStreamData.defaultUri; returns measurement ID and stream metadata.

tools.name: ga4_create_app_stream
tools.description: Create a mobile app data stream for a GA4 property

packageName.description: iOS bundle ID or Android package name

notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
tools.behavior: Creates an IOS_APP_DATA_STREAM with iosAppStreamData.bundleId or ANDROID_APP_DATA_STREAM with androidAppStreamData.packageName under propertyId.

tools.name: ga4_update_data_stream
tools.description: Update a data stream settings
notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
Nonempty displayName is required by handler although advertised as optional.
tools.behavior: Updates displayName for streamId using Admin updateDataStream and updateMask displayName.

tools.name: ga4_get_measurement_id
tools.description: Get the measurement ID (G-XXXXXXXXXX) for a web data stream
notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
Returns an error when webStreamData.measurementId is absent.
tools.behavior: Fetches a data stream using Admin getDataStream and returns web measurement ID, name and URI.

tools.name: ga4_delete_conversion_event
tools.description: Remove conversion marking from an event in GA4

notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
Returns errors for missing events and nondeletable system events.
tools.behavior: Lists property conversion events, finds an exact eventName match, checks deletable, then deletes that event by resource name.

tools.name: ga4_get_realtime
tools.description: Get real-time visitor data from GA4
notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
When omitted, metrics default to activeUsers; dimensions are omitted unless a nonempty array is supplied.
tools.behavior: Runs Data runRealtimeReport for propertyId; transforms dimension and metric names into name objects, maps response values into rows.

tools.name: ga4_run_report

notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
Description mentions limit default 10000, but handler does not set a default; omitted limit is left to API behavior.
tools.behavior: Runs Data runReport using propertyId, dateRanges, dimension and metric name objects, and optional limit/offset; returns rows, headers, total row count, currency and time zone.

tools.behavior: Runs Data runPivotReport with dateRanges, dimension/metric names and each pivot fieldNames/limit; returns dimension values, metric-value arrays, pivot headers and report headers.

tools.name: ga4_batch_run_reports
tools.description: Run multiple GA4 reports in a single request
notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
tools.behavior: Runs Data batchRunReports with propertyId and supplied report requests; converts dimension/metric strings into name objects and returns mapped rows and headers for each report.

tools.description: Create a custom dimension in GA4

tools.name: ga4_create_custom_metric
tools.description: Create a custom metric in GA4

displayName.description: Display name for the metric (special characters will be replaced with underscores)

notes: Handler validates with a strict Zod object; unadvertised top-level fields are rejected although exposed JSON Schema omits additionalProperties: false.
Internal Zod validator accepts optional scope with default EVENT; scope is absent from the exposed JSON Schema and handler ignores it.
tools.behavior: Sanitizes displayName, maps measurementUnit to numeric enum, fixes scope to EVENT (1), then calls Admin createCustomMetric under propertyId; returns metadata and sanitization note.

tools.name: gsc_list_sites
tools.description: List all sites you have access to in Google Search Console
tools.behavior: Calls Search Console API v1 sites.list and returns selected response fields as JSON text.

tools.name: gsc_search_analytics
tools.description: Query search analytics data from Google Search Console (impressions, clicks, CTR, position)

dimensions.description: Dimensions to group by (country, device, page, query, searchAppearance, date)

type.description: Search type filter (web, image, video, news, discover, googleNews)

aggregationType.description: How to aggregate data (auto, byPage, byProperty)

dataState.description: Data freshness (all includes fresh data, final for finalized data)

notes: Handler-only Zod constraints: dimensions enum country/device/page/query/searchAppearance/date; type enum web/image/video/news/discover/googleNews; aggregationType enum auto/byPage/byProperty; dataState enum all/final; rowLimit 1..25000, startRow >= 0.

Filter-group validator requires filters; groupType if present must be and; every filter requires dimension, operator and expression. Filter dimension enum country/device/page/query/searchAppearance; operator enum contains/equals/notContains/notEquals/includingRegex/excludingRegex. These required fields and enums are not exposed in JSON Schema.
Descriptions mention rowLimit default 1000, but handler leaves it unset when omitted.
tools.behavior: Queries Search Console searchanalytics.query with siteUrl and a requestBody containing date bounds and supplied grouping, search type, filter groups, aggregation, pagination and freshness; returns clicks, impressions, CTR and position rows.

tools.name: adsense_generate_report
tools.description: Generate an AdSense report with earnings, page views, clicks, and impressions

metrics.description: Metrics to include (default: ESTIMATED_EARNINGS, PAGE_VIEWS, CLICKS, IMPRESSIONS)

dimensions.description: Dimensions to group by (e.g., DATE, COUNTRY_NAME, AD_UNIT_NAME)

notes: Handler sends date components under `dateRange.startDate.*` and `dateRange.endDate.*` keys; these are not the standard AdSense v2 `startDate.*` and `endDate.*` parameters, so date selection is defective.
Date strings are not validated beyond being strings before numeric splitting.
tools.behavior: Splits startDate/endDate strings into numeric year/month/day components and calls AdSense accounts.reports.generate; defaults metrics to ESTIMATED_EARNINGS/PAGE_VIEWS/CLICKS/IMPRESSIONS and dimensions to DATE; maps cells into header-keyed rows and returns totals/averages.

notes: Source review only; no tools/list, upstream execution or live authenticated requests.

Registration is unconditional: auth_status plus analytics, Search Console and AdSense tool arrays. OAuth credentials are required at startup; missing stored refresh token permits startup but blocks every tool except auth_status. Token check is local refresh-token presence, not a live validity check.
Node >=20 and package dependencies required; package bin points to built dist/index.js, generated by tsup.
CLI auth, auth --status, auth --logout and help are not MCP tools. No Google Ads implementation is registered.
Explicit JSON Schemas are preserved literally, including omissions; runtime Zod restrictions are documented separately rather than inserted into advertised schemas.

review.method: Root AST parser exactly compared all 35 input schemas/full descriptions, checked combined allTools/allHandlers exports and the call dispatcher; inspected GA4 provisioning/report handlers and marked GSC/AdSense separately.
